items.title: Hugging Face Explores $13 Billion Sale a Month After a Rogue OpenAI Agent Hacked It
items.summary: The open-source AI hub is fielding buyout interest at nearly triple its 2023 valuation, weeks after a security breach and days after Stripe's OpenRouter deal reset the price of AI infrastructure.

items.title: CFTC, US soldier accused of illegal Polymarket bet spar over interpretation of prediction markets
items.summary: A judge stayed the CFTC’s civil case against a soldier who allegedly used nonpublic information for a Polymarket bet, but the regulator is trying to weigh in on the criminal case.

items.title: Strive Buys $81.5 Million in Bitcoin After Issuing More Shares
items.summary: The company increased its Bitcoin holdings by 5.5%, but its Bitcoin per fully diluted share rose only about 1.4%.

items.title: Bitcoin Stalls a Cent Below $80,000 as Altcoins Give Back Weekend Gains
items.summary: Bitcoin touched $79,999.99 on Coinbase before easing, its highest level since May, while 80 of the 123 largest non-stablecoin tokens fell on the day.
